prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV02 FAR BACKDROP for original mobile puzzle game Almost God. Full opaque LANDSCAPE 3:2 canvas, 1536 by 1024.
Primary request: A cheerful hillside garden kitchen district seen from a sunny open terrace: distant cream-and-ochre village roofs, green rolling cultivated hills, a few tall cypress trees, and tiny glass greenhouse rooftops catching turquoise light. This is only the far scenery behind a separate playable cooking courtyard.
Composition: Morning sky and pale peach clouds above a high horizon at the upper 30 percent. Small distant hillside houses and greenhouses remain in the upper third. Lower 70 percent is quiet low-contrast warm cream and terracotta garden light, mostly covered later by an independent floor layer. Keep central action space visually calm; no close furniture.
Style: polished broad-brush gouache on textured paper, warm children's adventure book, simplified handmade Mediterranean architecture, soft lavender shadows, sage green foliage, copper orange accents, light turquoise glazing. Painterly, not photographic.
Constraints: Complete opaque canvas. No foreground oven, no flame, no fire, no smoke or steam, no pool or water bowl, no big copper cooking pot, no kitchen tool, no food, no near plants, no props, no characters, no UI, no text, no watermark. This is distant scenery only, not a portrait phone screenshot.
